issues.title: Show template type in drop-down
issues.body:
A user is in  a channel with formatted messages.  The user clicks the dropdown, to choose a template type. The user selects a template type.  But, the drop-down now says `Select message`.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123960558-55f7c880-d9a7-11eb-9442-b53f6c012128.png)

When a template is selected, the drop-down should display the template name.

This should probably be implemented before #892
